title: Fig Calls Out in the Hedge
note: b418 — Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar, Moss the hedgehog and Nell the bee moving together along the base of a long, dark green hedge.
Fig the caterpillar pausing to look closely at a single green leaf, dropping behind the others on the hedge path.
Fig the caterpillar lifting his head towards an empty stretch of hedge path ahead of him.
Fig the caterpillar standing small and alone, dwarfed by tall, shadowy branches of a dark green hedge around him.
Fig the caterpillar with his head raised, calling out loudly into the hedge.
Nell the bee pausing mid-flight above a dark green hedge, turning her head towards a sound.
Nell the bee diving down through the branches of a dark green hedge, searching for Fig.
Nell the bee flying just ahead of Fig the caterpillar, guiding him along the hedge towards the open garden.
Fig the caterpillar gripping tightly to a brown twig, crawling steadily behind Nell the bee, determined to keep up.
Fig the caterpillar back in the open garden with Moss the hedgehog and Nell the bee, all three together again.
